g.text: When is a reaction chain replaceable?
Repeated chain growth can sometimes be lumped into an effective step or an aggregate state.
Remove internal states only after checking branches, storage, observables and stoichiometry.
Topology identifies a candidate. Chemistry and dynamics decide whether the closure is acceptable.
Local QSSA may follow either retained or aggregated motifs; topology alone does not establish timescale separation.
Conceptual reduction alternatives; no automatic state deletion or validated closure
